method: continuous native fixed-bone gait with world-distance foot planting and painted joint overlap
parts_provider: built-in image_gen, reused original painted parts
parts_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / production game character rig asset.
Use the reference's EXACT protagonist and hand-painted side-view game style. Create a TRANSPARENT PAPER-DOLL PARTS ATLAS for a fixed-bone 2D running rig, not a sequence of full-body poses.
Output EXACTLY 3 columns by 3 rows, nine equal square cells, ideally 1536x1536. Isolated component in each cell, lots of clear alpha padding. NO labels, numbers, grid lines or backdrop.
Same fine black contour, painted shadows, black high ponytail, red scarf, teal torn cape, dark brown/charcoal shirt and trousers, brown boots, gold fasteners and gold-hilt short steel sword as the reference. No redesign. All parts face RIGHT in orthographic side view, no perspective.
Cell order LEFT TO RIGHT then TOP TO BOTTOM:
1. The UPPER BODY only: head, ponytail, neck, chest, both bent arms and hands carrying the short sword low and forward, waist belt and the very top of the trouser pelvis. Running forward lean. The body ends smoothly just below the belt at the two hip joints. ABSOLUTELY NO THIGHS, SHINS OR FEET in this cell. The scarf knot and gold clasp may remain, but NO long red scarf tails and NO teal cape: those are separate cells 8 and 9. Preserve original face and proportions.
2. NEAR upper leg / thigh: one isolated straight dark-trousered thigh piece, hip joint at TOP and rounded knee joint at BOTTOM. Vertical neutral orientation. No shin or foot. Both joint ends are rounded with a little overlap for seamless rotation.
3. NEAR lower leg / shin: one isolated straight shin with the brown boot shaft, knee joint at TOP and ankle joint at BOTTOM, vertical neutral orientation. No toe or foot. Same knee thickness as cell 2.
4. NEAR boot FOOT: isolated brown shoe/boot-foot with ankle opening at its top, heel left and toe pointing RIGHT, in neutral horizontal orientation. Correct sturdy short boot, not a long clown shoe. Ankle overlap for rotation.
5. FAR upper leg / thigh: EXACTLY THE SAME SHAPE AND SIZE as cell 2, with slightly darker shading because it sits behind the near leg. Hip at top, knee at bottom. No shin or foot.
6. FAR lower leg / shin: EXACTLY THE SAME SHAPE AND SIZE as cell 3, with slightly darker shading. Knee top, ankle bottom. No foot.
7. FAR boot FOOT: EXACTLY THE SAME SHAPE AND SIZE as cell 4, slightly darker shading. Toe RIGHT, ankle top.
8. The isolated TEAL TORN CAPE from the reference, as one intact flowing fabric piece with its shoulder attachment at the upper right and torn tails trailing LEFT. No body or skin. The ragged cloth should have the same folds, outline and color as the reference.
9. The isolated RED SCARF TAILS from the reference, flowing LEFT from the neck attachment on the RIGHT, no head or body.
Important: These are ASSEMBLY PARTS of ONE consistent anatomical character. One fixed thigh and shin length each. Do not put a whole character in the leg cells, do not give independent running poses, do not add skeleton lines or bones. Each part is fully painted clean game artwork with two rounded overlap zones where appropriate. All components wholly inside their own cells, zero clipping, no detached specks. True transparent alpha, no floor, cast shadow, scenery, text or watermark.
weight_transfer_keys: impact -> compression -> passing -> push -> toe-off -> flight -> descent
foot_contact: heel -> flat sole -> toe; each contact point is pinned to world travel
